title: ShareNotification/set args
description: Arguments for ShareNotification/set (RFC 9670 §4.3). Destroy-only: create and update are not supported.

accountId.description: The account to apply changes to.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard. Fails with stateMismatch if the ShareNotification state differs.

create.description: Always results in notCreated — share notifications are created by the server.

update.description: Always results in notUpdated — share notifications are immutable.
